I always figured businesses didn't want you smoking e-cigs inside mostly for appearance sake, and was therefore further surprised to find states considering total bans over health concerns, and some cities (NY, LA, etc) already having passed bans. Many seem to claim secondhand e-cig smoke to be at least as dangerous as cigarette smoke. My own (admittedly not comprehensive) research had led me to believe that science found the e-cig vapor to be much less harmful to both the user and even less to bystanders.

I feel really lucky and grateful for how they raised my sisters and I.

So on that note, we were all put into team sports and camps when we were of age, I got thrown into soccer because my sisters liked it and the teams practiced on the same field/same times. Cue an opportunity at convenience for my mom. Smart mama.

I took to it stupidly well. I ate that shit up like pickles (I had a peculiar fixation of a strict diet of pickles when I was 7). Within a few years I was at premier club level. I enjoyed th activity, the runs around my neighborhood lagoons or to the beach. I also loved how it functioned as a multifaceted relationship and awareness of your teammates strengths, weaknesses, potential, and just be creative with your moves and plays.

Not before long I was practicing with a girls team 5 years older than I was, at the age of 11 and 12. My two sisters happened to be on that team. My mom loved seeing us on the field together and we shortly jumped on the same team for indoor soccer. We were legit that 100% soccer family, luckily without all the parental drama on and off the field. A string of great coaches, a praised level of progression in my skills, and the adrenaline I got from playing in a state cup with girls thinking of college when I'm not yet in high school. I dabble with leagues every now and then (26 as of now), and my mom even came to watch me play in a game where I scored this amazing threaded shot that drove itself on the ground into the side netting. USWNT, great job on Sunday! You bet your butt I saw all 7 goals :)
